title: Senior backend interview at a Karachi payments company

brief.title: Senior Backend Engineer at Zarya Pay
brief.goals: Show the driver payouts and reconciliation work; ask about the team and the first project
brief.done: Sent the CV; passed the first-round coding test
brief.instructions: Keep answers short. I have not used Kotlin in production; say so honestly.

documents.title: CV
documents.text:
Hamza Qureshi. Backend engineer, 6 years. Laravel, PHP 8, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis.
2021-2025 Savari Rides, Karachi: built the driver payouts service, 40,000 payouts a day; cut reconciliation from 3 days to 4 hours.
2019-2021 Bazaarline, Karachi: order and returns API in Laravel.
BS Computer Science, NED University, 2019.
Notice period: one month.

events.text: Hi Sana, thanks for having me.
Thanks for joining, Hamza. I lead the payments team here at Zarya Pay.
Before we go into the technical part, what salary are you looking for?
events.reference:
I'd like to understand the full package for this level first.
- **Open**: flexible for the right role
Say next: What range have you set for this position?

events.text: I'm looking for 450,000 rupees a month.
Tell me about the payouts system you built at Savari.
events.reference:
I built the driver payouts service at Savari Rides.
- **Scale**: 40,000 payouts a day
- **Result**: reconciliation from 3 days to 4 hours

bad.answer:

events.text: I built the driver payouts service. It handled 40,000 payouts a day, and I cut reconciliation from three days to four hours.

events.reference:

events.text: On-call here is one week in every six, and we pay extra for it.
How do you handle a payout that fails halfway?
events.reference:
I make every payout step safe to retry.
- **Idempotency**: one key per payout
- **Reconciliation**: a daily job finds and fixes half-done payouts

bad.answer: Retry each step up to 3 times, then flag it for a person to check.
